_PROVENANCE: LEAKAGE-FREE RETRAIN of the actual SentinelSpeciesHealthIndex network. The shipped training script built the 256-d input embedding with positions 4-9 = log1p(per-species counts), which DEFINE the occupancy labels (count>0 == present) -> the previously reported AUROC=1.000 / occ_acc=0.999 / health_r2=0.9996 are CIRCULAR (label read off the input). Here the input embedding is rebuilt from genuinely independent predictors ONLY (geographic lat/lon/|lat|/elev, watershed log-drainage + HUC2 one-hot, NON-target community richness/count computed AFTER dropping the 6 target taxa, sampling effort, and real matched USGS sensor water-quality stats for 54 sites). Per-species counts are REMOVED entirely. Same real USGS BioData, same seed=42 spatial hash holdout split. The 2 always-absent species (Hellbender, Pearl Mussel) are dropped. This is the full network retrained end-to-end, NOT a probe -- the reported numbers are this honest network's held-out test skill.
data_source: USGS BioData (real surveys) + matched USGS sensor stations
split: spatial hash holdout (sha256 of seed:site_id, mod 10)
leaked_features_removed: embedding positions 4-9: per-species log1p(count) (define the labels)
sensor_note: 54 USGS NWIS sensor stations match site-IDs in the FULL sites table, but NONE of them overlap the 5462 sites that have any of the 6 target taxa, so within this model's site universe there are 0 real sensor matches. The wq_* feature columns are therefore entirely median-imputed (constant) and contribute no real signal here -- they are kept for schema parity but are effectively inert. The reported skill comes from geography, watershed, NON-target community context, and sampling effort.

baseline_comparison.note: Leaked numbers are circular. The honest GBM probe was an unbiased ESTIMATE on the leakage-free features; this entry is the ACTUAL full network retrained on those features.
